text: This report recommends the award of the Request for Tender for the Splash Island – Washroom Upgrades project.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the Request for Tender TZC T 11 (2022-02) - Splash Island - Washroom Upgrades. 2. Awarded the project to Twin Contracting in the amount of $674,000.00, excluding applicable taxes.
